title: Open-composition unit on a restricted source complex
statement:
For a scheme morphism h, an open W, an arbitrary complex I on X and the canonical derived composition comparison beta, the h-localization unit on the open-image complex, Rh of the open-localization unit on the termwise restriction J, and beta at QJ compose to Q of the underived complex-composition map, then the W-open localization unit and the W-derived direct image of the restricted-morphism localization unit. There is no exact restriction factor or derived restriction comparison in this equation. Definitions: [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data], [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data], [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-counit-model]. Exact Lean statement:
theorem schemeMVOpenComposition_restricted_source_unit
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (β : schemeDerivedDirectImage (h ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage h ≅
      schemeDerivedDirectImage (h ∣_ W) ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage W.ι)
    (hβ : β = (schemeMVDirectImageComposition (h ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι h).symm ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg schemeDerivedDirectImage (morphismRestrict_ι h W).symm) ≪≫
      schemeMVDirectImageComposition (h ∣_ W) W.ι)
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let J := ((schemeOpenRestriction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I
    let G := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (h ∣_ W).toLRSHom.toShHom
    let RY := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage W.ι.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let b₀ := (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
        (schemeMVUnderivedOpenComposition h W) (.up ℤ) ≪≫
      (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl (G ⋙ RY)) (.up ℤ)).symm).hom.app J
    (schemeMVDirectImageLocalization h).app (schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W) I) ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map
        ((schemeMVDirectImageLocalization (h ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).app J) ≫
      β.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj J) =
    DerivedCategory.Q.map b₀ ≫
      (schemeMVDirectImageLocalization W.ι).app
        ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J) ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage W.ι).map
        ((schemeMVDirectImageLocalization (h ∣_ W)).app J)

proof.text: Put J equal to the termwise restriction of I. The open-image complex is definitionally equal to termwise open pushforward of J, since objects and differentials apply the same composite functor and scheme pushforward is the ringed-space module direct image. Apply schemeMVOpenComposition_complex_localization to X, Y, h, W, beta, its canonicality equation and J. Lean accepts this exact application without transport, naturality or any new assumption.
